prompt: Create a cinematic anime short-film still of a dynamic jewelry heist fight inside a luxurious modern shopping mall. The frame is a horizontal 16:9 shot with a slightly wide-angle camera, shallow depth of field, subtle motion blur, and bright afternoon sunlight streaming through a huge glass skylight ceiling. In the foreground, show a sleek illuminated glass jewelry display case filled with white velvet trays, gold necklaces, rings, and sparkling diamonds; the main character is an athletic anime heroine, Rin, wearing a black cyber-ninja streetwear outfit with cropped top, arm straps, short skirt panels, thigh straps, and chunky black sneakers with pink accents. She is mid-leap on top of the glass case, one knee raised, long flowing black hair whipping dramatically behind her, holding a small black pistol or tactical gadget while twisting away from an attacker. Include exactly 1 masked robber in the left foreground, dressed head-to-toe in matte black tactical clothing and balaclava, crouching and lunging toward her. Background details: a high-end mall atrium with polished floors, curved balconies, warm ceiling lights, glass railings, a tiered crystal perfume display tower at center, elegant jewelry counters, and one visible luxury storefront sign reading DANCE. Mood is fast, glamorous, and tense, like a 15-second anime action clip frozen at the most exciting moment. Color palette: warm champagne mall lighting, creamy whites, reflective glass, black clothing, pink shoe accents, and sparkling highlights. Add a video-player style presentation around the image: black dotted interface background, rounded-rectangle preview frame with thin gray border, small camera icon and title text at top left reading Anime Mall Jewelry Heist Fight, a small expand icon in the top-right corner of the preview, a circular right-arrow button outside the preview on the right, and a thin progress scrubber with a white handle on the left edge. Keep all text crisp and minimal, no extra logos or watermarks.
